$meta.name: Local Operator design tokens
$meta.source: src/index.css (@theme block) — the shipped source of truth
$meta.hexCase: lowercase, matching src/index.css; hex case is not significant
$meta.ratioMethod: WCAG 2.x relative-luminance formula on sRGB hex, rounded to 2dp
$meta.themeContract: Light values are the document default. Dark values apply when an ancestor carries the theme flag (class `dark` on <html> in the reference implementation; tokens.css uses `.theme-dark` to avoid colliding with a framework's own class). Tokens with no `dark` key are theme-invariant by design.
$meta.notDtcg: This file is NOT DTCG and is not consumable by Style Dictionary without a loader. It uses no $value/$type, it carries light/dark as sibling keys rather than as theme sets, and several values are human-readable prose. That is deliberate: the `role` strings and the $note/$cap/$round annotations are the reason the file is worth reading at all, and DTCG can only carry them as vendor extensions. README.md ships a complete reader in about twenty lines; contrast-contract.mjs is a second, working consumer of exactly this shape.

shape.keysBeginningWith$: Metadata, never a token. Skip them when walking a group.
shape.colorToken: Either { light, dark, role? } for a theme-varying colour, or { value, role? } for a theme-invariant one. A reader resolves a theme with `t.value ?? t[theme]`.
shape.typeToken: { size, px, lineHeight, weight, letterSpacing, face, transform? }. `size` is the authored rem string; `px` is the same value at a 16px root, precomputed so a consumer never has to.
shape.proseValues: space.rhythm.*, space.sectionDensity.hero.* ("72/48" is top/bottom) and radius.$cap/$round are prose. Nothing machine-generated should depend on them.
shape.units: Colours are hex. Type sizes are rem strings with a px sibling. Space, radii and containers are CSS-ready strings with units. Durations are ms strings. Line heights and weights are numbers.

$meta.checkedBy: contrast-contract.mjs — `node contrast-contract.mjs` recomputes every permitted foreground x ground pair and every component triple in both themes and exits non-zero on a violation. Run it after editing any colour in this file.

font.mono: "JetBrains Mono Variable", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

band.role: green-tinted band ground, max two bands per page

ink-disabled.role: disabled control text only; exempt under SC 1.4.3

hairline.role: decorative 1px rule; never a sole boundary

hairline-strong.role: hover borders, outline-button rest border, frame edge

border-control.role: structural: control borders and any 1px rule that is the sole boundary of required content

accent.role: links, active state, focus ring, primary fill

accent-border.role: 1px border on tinted chips, callout rules, selected card

accent-wash.role: faintest tint: callout ground, hover tint

accent-muted.role: solid tinted fill: badge, active segmented item, selection

island.$note: Theme-invariant by construction. Defined once, never re-pointed. These two surfaces quote the product's own night in both themes.

island.role: code block and player chrome ground

island-muted.role: secondary island text, plain syntax role

island-edge.role: island outer 1px edge in both themes

fixed.$note: Literal values the system commits to. Not part of either ramp; exposed in tokens.css under these exact names.

focus-ring-photo-inner.role: inner stroke of the two-tone ring over photographic grounds

focus-ring-photo-outer.role: outer stroke of the same ring

type.$note: size / lineHeight are unitless multipliers as shipped. `face` names which family the step must be paired with; the step itself never encodes a family.

measure.$note: Reading measures, in ch. Not container widths — these apply to the text element itself. KIT ADDITION: the reference site implements all three as static utility classes, so `getPropertyValue('--measure')` is empty on the running build. tokens.css exposes them as custom properties; the values are the site's.

space.$note: Two ramps of multipliers of `base`, and the split is load-bearing: `componentSteps` is what a lint rule should enforce for anything inside a component, and `sectionSteps` covers section padding only — it contains exactly the sectionDensity values below, five of which are deliberately absent from the component ramp. Arbitrary values are prohibited on both. A single combined list either cannot express the section ladder or adds five steps nothing inside a component should use.

breakpoint.$note: Tailwind v4 defaults, as shipped by the site.

radius.$cap: 10px is the dominant value. Nothing above 16px exists; the site removes the larger scale steps so an out-of-scale class renders a square corner instead of silently working.
radius.$round: border-radius: 9999px is permitted on exactly three things: the status dot, the play button, the toggle knob.

shadow.$note: There are exactly two. Elevation for in-flow content is a background step, never a shadow.

overlay.role: drawer, dialog, popover, select menu — objects that leave the flow

contrastFloors.$note: Applies to every foreground the system ships except ink-disabled, which is exempt under SC 1.4.3 as an inactive control.
